title: 第1章 蛰院、涸龙
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“师兄，我们双修吧！”

茫茫山风之间，响起了一道清脆的女声，声音清冷悦耳。

但所吐之言，却有些骇人。

青天白日，朗朗乾坤，鉴天教山门清净之地，直言双修之事？

成何体统？

但陆玄闻言，面上却并无波澜，只是淡淡的摇头：“师妹，不可胡言……”

少女闻言，神色有些焦急，忍不住提高声音：“师兄，采炁失败，你我已经不再属于【蛰院】弟子，七日之后，一应精舍、脍堂、灵石等诸般待遇，都将取消……”

“唯有转修金甲玉躯之法，成为外门弟子，才可得享一份道禄，继续留在玉庭道场。”

“可一旦转修金甲玉躯之法，子嗣难诞，唯有在转修之前，阴阳交汇，留下精华，方可保证日后诞下灵婴！”

“论相貌、论身材、论性格、论道慧……我都是此番炼炁大醮余者之中上上者，师兄于我，乃是良配，日后我定然会为师兄诞下一个资质上佳的孩儿，师兄为何不愿？”

少女不解，同时有些疑惑，忍不住抬首问道：“师兄，难道我不美吗？”

陆玄抬起眸子，看着眼前琼鼻樱唇，雪肤黑发，五官如玉刀雕琢的少女，赞叹道：“师妹二八年华，皎若朝霞，自然是极美的……”

这句话，倒不是陆玄硬夸，这般年岁的少女，肤色如玉，骨相如天人，岂会不美？

若是用前世的话来说，当是顶美了。

只是……重活一世，还执着于皮相风流，那也太过下乘。

更何况，二八年华自然是美的，可若不是二八年华呢？

自得了记忆，了解此世的那一刻，陆玄心中已经对此生有了定计。

可少女并不理解，只是不解的问道：“既然如此，师兄为何不愿？”

“因为我不愿修行金甲玉躯之法……”

陆玄坦然直言。

此话一出，少女倒是一怔，随即一叹：

“我知晓师兄是有心气的，我又何尝不是？”

“三载习文，三载读经，三载修行，入【蛰院】九载，谁不想采炁功成，得入内门，成为真正的修行者？”

“只是，只是如今，采炁失败，如涸龙丧……为之奈何？”

少女斟酌着语句，没有将话说的太过直白。

但陆玄知晓她的意思。

金甲玉躯之法，是鉴天教【蛰院】弟子采炁失败之后转修的法门，此法另辟蹊径，可令寻常胎息弟子拥有炼炁之境界，甚至还可筑基，在教中也算是一股不弱的力量。

但寿元止步二百六十载。

药石无医，灵丹无用，且子嗣难诞。

被教中弟子戏称为【涸龙力士】之法。

意味着【蛰院】弟子失败，蛰龙干涸身死而习的法门。

但这是文雅的说法，粗鄙一些就直接就是“丧家败犬”。

此刻少女说出这番话，意思已经很明显了。

你我都采炁失败，如败犬丧途，再有心气又如何？还挑什么呢？

想要留在鉴天教，留在玉庭道场，就只能转修金甲玉躯之法。

这也是这几日陆玄精舍之中，女修来往不绝的原因。

除非是不愿生子的，否则但凡有繁衍之心，都会在这几日寻一道侣，敲定此事。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Senior brother, let's practice dual cultivation!"

In the vast mountain breeze, a clear female voice sounded, the voice was cold and sweet.

But the words he spat out were somewhat horrifying.

The blue sky and white sun, the bright universe, the pure place at the gate of Jiantian Sect, can you speak frankly about the dual cultivation?

In what manner?

But when Lu Xuan heard this, there was no emotion on his face. He just shook his head lightly: "Junior sister, don't talk nonsense..."

Hearing this, the girl looked a little anxious and couldn't help but raise her voice: "Senior brother, the harvesting failed, you and I are no longer disciples of [Zheyuan]. After seven days, all benefits such as Yiying Jingshe, Xiantang, Lingshi, etc. will be cancelled..."

"Only by practicing the method of Golden Armor and Jade Body and becoming an outer disciple, can you enjoy a share of Taoism and continue to stay in the Jade Court Dojo."

"But once you practice the Golden Armor and Jade Body method, it will be difficult to give birth to an heir. Only when the yin and yang meet and leave the essence before you practice, can you guarantee the birth of a spiritual baby in the future!"

"In terms of appearance, figure, personality, wisdom... I am the best among the remaining people who have made this Qi Qi Jiao. Senior brother is a good match for me. I will definitely give birth to a child with excellent qualifications for senior brother in the future. Why don't you want to?"

The girl was puzzled and a little confused. She couldn't help but raise her head and asked: "Brother, am I not beautiful?"

Lu Xuan raised his eyes and looked at the girl in front of him with a beautiful nose and cherry lips, snow-skinned black hair, and facial features like a jade knife. He admired: "Junior sister is twenty-eight years old, as bright as the morning glow, so she is naturally extremely beautiful..."

This sentence is not something that Lu Xuan is bragging about. How could a girl of her age not be beautiful with her skin as jade-like and her bones as celestial?

If I were to use the words of my previous life, it would be extremely beautiful.

It's just... that it's too inferior to live a new life and still be obsessed with superficial love.

What's more, 28-year-old flowers are naturally beautiful, but what if they are not 28-year-old flowers?

The moment he gained his memory and understood this world, Lu Xuan already had a plan for this life in his heart.

But the girl didn't understand, and just asked in confusion: "If that's the case, why don't senior brothers want to?"

"Because I don't want to practice the method of golden armor and jade body..."

Lu Xuan spoke frankly.

As soon as these words came out, the girl was startled, and then sighed:

"I know that senior brother is angry, so why am I not?"

"Three years of studying essays, three years of reading scriptures, three years of practice, and nine years of entering the Hidden Garden. Who doesn't want to succeed in gathering Qi, enter the inner sect, and become a true practitioner?"

"It's just, it's just that now, the failure of harvesting Qi is like a dragon dying...what can we do?"

The girl carefully considered her words and did not speak too directly.

But Lu Xuan knew what she meant.

The method of Golden Armor and Jade Body is a method that disciples of Jiantian Sect [Zheyuan] turned to practice after they failed in collecting Qi. This method is a new way to allow ordinary disciples of Fetal Breath to have the realm of Qi refining, and even build foundations. It is also considered a powerful force in the sect.

But longevity stopped at 260 years.

Medicines and stones are useless, panaceas are useless, and it is difficult to have children.

It is jokingly called the "Dry Dragon Warrior" method by the disciples.

It means that the disciples of [Zheyuan] failed and the Hidden Dragon dried up and died.

But this is an elegant way of saying it. If it is cruder, it just means "lost family and lost dog".

At this moment, when the girl said these words, her meaning was already obvious.

You and I both failed to pick up Qi, just like a defeated dog that loses its way, so what if we still have the courage to do so?What else to choose?

If you want to stay in the Jiantian Sect and the Jade Court Dojo, you can only practice the Golden Armor and Jade Body method.

This is also the reason why female cultivators have been coming and going in Lu Xuan Jingshe these days.

Unless they don't want to have children, anyone who wants to reproduce will find a partner in these days to finalize the matter.
